description.zh: 由抽公因式開始，學會分組、恆等式與十字相乘。
description.en: Start with common factors, then learn grouping, identities and the cross-method.

description.zh: 由代入與消元，學會把價格、比例及路程條件寫成兩條方程。
description.en: Use substitution and elimination, then form equations for prices, proportions and journeys.

scope.zh: 二次方程與複數、直線方程、不等式、排列與組合
scope.en: Quadratic equations and complex numbers, straight lines, inequalities, permutations and combinations
